title: T.1. The interpass temperature shall be
_context:
maintained for the remainder of the weld. Should it be necessary to interrupt
welding, the assembly shall be allowed to cool in air. The assembly shall then be
heated to the prescribed interpass temperature before welding is resumed.
No thermal treatment of weldment or test specimens is permitted, except that
machined tensile test specimens may be aged at 93 °C to 104 °C for up to 48 hours,
then cooled to room temperature before testing.
T.4
Acceptance Criteria
The lowest and highest Charpy V-N
